systems.system: Gabinete de Gestão e Arquivo de Dados (GAD) / ANPG data management system
systems.owner: ANPG (Agência Nacional de Petróleo, Gás e Biocombustíveis)
systems.tiers: petroleum associates and credentialed service companies deliver data to it

note: Sector data-delivery regulation of the petroleum ministry; adopts international industry formats (SEG, API) but names no national standards body, national IT or data standard, or certification, so it is other and places nothing.
